tips.text: Throw Aqua Prison at where the enemy will be, not where they stand; the bubble takes a moment to land. Aim it at enemies walking up to last-hit or dodging.
Use Ebb and Flow on yourself or your ally in the middle of a trade so it heals and hurts the enemy at once.
Cast Tidecaller's Blessing on your damage dealer before a trade; their next attacks slow the enemy and deal extra damage.
Start fights from far away with Tidal Wave; it knocks enemies up and slows them, and it speeds up allies it passes through.
Aqua Prison has a long cooldown, so hold it for a real chance to kill or save someone rather than throwing it at nothing.
Your abilities give allies a burst of Move Speed when they hit, so use them to help a teammate escape or chase.
Aim Aqua Prison at Alistar when he walks up to engage. It takes a moment to land, so cast it where he is heading.
Stay away from Alistar's reach. Headbutt followed by Pulverize can burst you down, especially near a turret.
Hold Ebb and Flow until a fight starts. Bounce it between your ally and Alistar to heal and hurt in one cast.
Cast Tidecaller's Blessing on your carry before a trade; it slows the enemy and adds damage.
Wait for Unbreakable Will to end before you fight Alistar. Hit the fragile enemy instead while it lasts.
Aim Aqua Prison at Anivia when she is committed to casting; the stun leaves her open to your damage and your ally's.
Stay out of Flash Frost's line; it passes through units, so hiding behind minions won't save you.
Step away once Flash Frost has hit you; Frostbite deals far more damage to a chilled target.
Give your ally Tidecaller's Blessing before they trade; it slows Anivia and adds damage.
Look for kills while Anivia is in egg form; do not walk away, because she comes back at full health if it survives.
Use Ebb and Flow to heal your ally and hit Anivia in one cast when she pokes you.
Aim Aqua Prison at the spot Bard is walking to, not where he stands; the bubble takes a moment to land. Use it when he steps up to chime or poke.
Walk over Bard's shrines to destroy them before his ally can use them. Do it when they are standing in the lane.
Bard's Cosmic Binding stuns only if it hits two enemies or a wall. Stand apart from your partner and away from walls so it cannot stun you.
Use Ebb and Flow on your carry when Bard trades. It heals your ally and can bounce to Bard for damage.
Tidal Wave is blocked by Bard's Tempered Fate stasis, so hold it until the stasis ends. Avoid ending up inside Tempered Fate with your team out of position.
Keep minions between you and Blitzcrank, because Rocket Grab hits only the first enemy in its path.
Hold Aqua Prison for when Blitzcrank misses Rocket Grab or walks up to trade. He has no way to avoid it once it lands.
Stay out of his range while Rocket Grab is ready. Standing at the edge of its range gives him a chance to hit you.
Watch for Overdrive: he is fast and closes in quickly, but is slowed after it ends, so punish him then.
Respect Static Field at level 6; it silences you and removes your shields, which cuts your protection.
Brand needs to land a spell to start his combo, so dodge Sear and Pillar of Flame and he does little.
Aim Aqua Prison at Brand when he steps up to cast; his Sear has to be lined up and he has no escape.
Stand apart from your carry, since Conflagration spreads to everyone nearby.
Keep moving once Brand burns you; Pillar of Flame has a delay and can be walked out of.
Step away from your allies when Pyroclasm is thrown; it starts slowly and bounces between nearby enemies.
Throw Aqua Prison when Braum's Unbreakable is down or pointed elsewhere; the shield will destroy the bubble if it faces you.
Stay out of the range where Braum can land Winter's Bite; being slowed there lets him stack Concussive Blows quickly.
Step out of the way of Glacial Fissure during its long cast, and don't walk across the icy ground it leaves.
Use Tidecaller's Blessing on your carry before a trade so their hits slow Braum and his partner.
Save Aqua Prison for when Camille uses Hookshot to come at you. A stun mid-fight lets your team punish her.
Stay away from walls when Camille's Hookshot is ready. She needs terrain to dash from, so stay clear of it.
Give your carry Tidecaller's Blessing before a trade so Camille is slowed when she tries to close in.
Be careful of The Hextech Ultimatum once Camille reaches level 6. It traps you with no escape, so stay near allies.
Hit Camille with Ebb and Flow when she steps in, and heal your ally on the bounce.
Aim Aqua Prison where Janna will stand, since the bubble lands after a short delay. Stunned, she is easy to punish.
Dodge Howling Gale by listening for its charge-up. Step sideways once it is released, because it travels in a line.
Janna's Monsoon can interrupt your engage. Hold Tidal Wave until she has used it or cannot reach your allies.
Use Ebb and Flow on Janna and your ally together in a trade, so it hurts her and heals you.
Throw Aqua Prison when Karma walks up to trade, or when she uses Focused Resolve. Her short-range options leave her exposed.
Break Focused Resolve's tether by moving out of range, so you avoid the root. Stay back when Mantra is ready, since the root lasts longer.
Stay out of a line with minions in front; Inner Flame bursts on the first unit it hits and splashes nearby enemies. Dodge the circle Soulflare leaves behind.
Use Ebb and Flow to heal your carry while it hits Karma too. Bounce it through both of you in trades.
Keep Aqua Prison for when Leona commits with Zenith Blade, or aim it at where she will land. A hit stops her combo.
Stay out of Zenith Blade's long range, and keep minions between you and Leona when you can.
When Leona raises Eclipse, walk away from her. It goes off after a short delay and hurts only those still close.
Dodge the center of Solar Flare by moving as soon as you see it land. Tidal Wave is a good answer to her engage, because it knocks up and slows her.
Aim Aqua Prison where Lulu will walk, not where she stands; it lands after a delay. Landing it gives you a free trade.
Keep minions between you and Lulu's Glitterlance, and stay out of its long range; Pix's bolts can also be blocked by minions.
Stay out of Whimsy range when she's ready; being polymorphed is deadly if your carry is nearby.
Use Ebb and Flow to hit Lulu and heal your carry in the same cast during trades.
Fire Tidal Wave to start a fight from far away. Watch for Lulu's Wild Growth to turn the fight around.
Hold Aqua Prison until Lux walks up or uses a spell. If it lands, your team gets a free trade.
Stay out of the line between Lux and you. Light Binding stops at no one, so a minion in front does not fully protect you.
Step out of Lucent Singularity right away; the slow stays on you briefly after the blast. Do not stand in it while it is about to go off.
Put Tidecaller's Blessing on your carry before they trade. Each hit slows Lux or her partner.
Use Ebb and Flow when Lux is near your partner. It damages her and heals your ally as it bounces.
Move sideways when you see Final Spark's red warning beam, especially when you are low on health.
Keep Aqua Prison for when Maokai walks in; if he is stunned, you get a free trade. Don't throw it when he can dodge with Twisted Advance.
Stay out of Twisted Advance range; Maokai roots whoever he reaches, so keep your distance when your bubble is down.
Don't spend Ebb and Flow damage on Maokai just to hit him; hitting him with spells makes his self-heal come back sooner.
Watch brush for Maokai's Sapling Toss; walk around any sapling instead of stepping into it, because it chases and slows you.
Watch for his Nature's Grasp from the flank; a bubble or Tidal Wave can punish him if he misses it.
Wait for Mel to use Rebuttal before you throw Aqua Prison or Tidal Wave; it destroys enemy projectiles and she gets a shield from it.
Aim Aqua Prison at where Mel will be, since the bubble lands after a delay. Cast it when she is rooted or busy, not when she can walk away.
Mel's Solar Snare roots at long range, so stay out of its line or keep a minion in front of you. If she misses, step in and trade.
Back off when Mel's Overwhelm stacks build and your health gets low, since her damage can finish you. Let the stacks fall off before you go in again.
Ebb and Flow can bounce off Mel to your ally and back, so use it in a trade to damage her and heal your carry.
Put Tidecaller's Blessing on your carry before a trade; their hits slow Mel and make her harder to chase down.
Throw Aqua Prison at Milio when he steps up to cast; he cannot easily dodge it, and he cannot cast while the bubble holds him.
Aim Aqua Prison where Milio will be, not where he stands. The bubble lands after a short delay.
Use Ebb and Flow on your carry during a trade. It hits Milio or his partner too and bounces back to heal you both.
Put Tidecaller's Blessing on your carry before they fight. Their hits then leave the enemy slowed and are easy to follow up.
Fire Tidal Wave from far away at a group. It travels slowly, so aim it where they will be walking.
Hold Tidal Wave for when Milio has used Breath of Life, or time it to knock them up. Breath of Life cannot cleanse being knocked up.
Stay behind minions when you stand in range of Dark Binding. It stops at the first enemy it hits, so minions soak it up.
Wait for Morgana to spend Black Shield before you throw Aqua Prison. If she shields herself, the stun does nothing.
Aqua Prison lands after a delay, so aim it where Morgana is walking. She can dodge it easily if you throw it at her feet.
Move out of Tormented Shadow quickly, especially when you are low on health. It deals more damage the lower you are.
Use Ebb and Flow to heal your carry and hit Morgana in the same cast. It bounces between allies and enemies.
Stay out of range when Morgana reaches level 6. If Soul Shackles catches you, break the chains by moving away before they pull tight.
Stay behind your minions so Dredge Line has a harder time reaching you. Nautilus's anchor stops at the first enemy it hits.
Land Aqua Prison on Nautilus as he walks up to engage. It stuns him and the delay means you should aim where he is heading.
Hold still when Riptide goes off right next to you until the waves finish. Running early takes extra hits and slows you.
Shield your carry with Tidecaller's Blessing before a fight so their attacks slow Nautilus when he dives in.
Don't let Nautilus land his first attack on you. Staggering Blow roots you in place, which sets up his stun.
Throw Aqua Prison at Neeko when she commits to a fight or walks up to poke; the bubble stuns her and breaks any disguise she has on.
Aim Aqua Prison at where Neeko is heading, not where she stands. The bubble takes a moment to land, so she can walk out of it.
Stay out of line with Tangle-Barbs, and keep minions from standing between you and Neeko. It grows stronger after it hits something.
After Neeko wastes Tangle-Barbs, step up and trade with Ebb and Flow or Aqua Prison. She is much weaker while it is on cooldown.
Be wary of allied champions or minions that act oddly. Neeko may be disguised as one, and her Pop Blossom warning is hidden while she is disguised.
Use Tidecaller's Blessing on your carry before they trade with Neeko, so their next hits slow her and deal extra damage.
Save Aqua Prison for when Pantheon jumps or walks in; the stun stops his combo and his Aegis Assault.
Stay away from low health; Pantheon's thrown Comet Spear hits much harder on weak targets.
Move away from the landing circle when Pantheon starts Grand Starfall; there is warning before he arrives.
Give your carry Tidecaller's Blessing before a trade so their hits leave Pantheon slowed.
Use Ebb and Flow in the middle of a trade to hurt Pantheon and heal your ally.
Do not rely on dashing to get away from Poppy; Steadfast Presence stops dashes, so walk out of her range instead.
Stay away from walls when Poppy is near; Heroic Charge carries you into terrain and stuns you.
Aim Aqua Prison at Poppy when she walks toward you. Landing it stops her engage, so save it for that.
Step on Poppy's buckler after Iron Ambassador to destroy it and deny her the shield.
When Poppy starts spinning her hammer, she is charging Keeper's Verdict. Move out of its line so it misses.
Give your partner Tidecaller's Blessing before a trade; their hits slow Poppy and add magic damage.
Use Ebb and Flow to poke Poppy while healing your partner as it bounces between you.
Aim Aqua Prison at Pyke when he winds up Bone Skewer or dashes in. The bubble lands after a short delay, so aim where he is heading.
Keep your ally healthy with Ebb and Flow. Pyke wants to get an ally low, and his Death From Below can execute them.
Stay behind your minions and your ally. Bone Skewer stops at the first enemy it hits, so minions in front of you can block it.
Use Tidal Wave when Pyke is far away or low on health. He can turn invisible and heal, so keep him slowed and in sight.
Give your ally Tidecaller's Blessing before they trade. The slow stops Pyke from escaping or closing in.
Hold Aqua Prison until Rakan commits with Grand Entrance or dashes in; stunned, he can't escape and his team can punish him.
Aqua Prison lands after a short delay, so aim where Rakan will be, not where he stands. Rakan's dashes show where he is heading.
Use Ebb and Flow on Rakan to hit him and bounce to your ally, giving heal and speed. It also pokes him when he stands near your carry.
Look for Rakan when he is away from his partner. His mobility suffers when alone, so Aqua Prison is easier to land.
Tidal Wave can catch Rakan after he lands from Grand Entrance; he is knocked up and slowed, so your team can finish him.
Throw Aqua Prison at Rell when she leaps in with Ferromancy: Crash Down; she can't use Shattering Strike's lunge or dodge while suspended.
Aim Aqua Prison where Rell is walking, not at her feet. It lands after a short delay, so she can step out of it.
Stay behind your minions and away from Rell's reach; Shattering Strike stuns and also destroys your shields.
Use Tidal Wave from far away to start a fight; Rell has to cross a long way slowed while the wave's slow lingers.
Ebb and Flow trades with Rell and heals your carry in the same cast, so use it when she is standing near both of you.
Land Aqua Prison when Senna walks up for souls or to attack; being stunned in place makes her an easy target.
Senna outranges you, so avoid standing in her line; Last Embrace roots you after a short delay, so sidestep it.
Give your carry Tidecaller's Blessing before a trade so their hits slow Senna.
Use Ebb and Flow in a fight to heal your ally and hurt Senna as it bounces.
Tidal Wave from far away can start a fight on Senna and knock her up so your team can reach her.
Aim Aqua Prison at where Seraphine will be, not where she stands; the bubble lands late. Use it when she steps up for a trade.
Seraphine's Beat Drop slows then roots when you are already slowed. Avoid being slowed by enemies before she casts it.
Dodge High Note by moving sideways as it lands; it hurts most when you are low on health, so stay healthy with Ebb and Flow.
Tidal Wave travels slowly, so use it on Seraphine from long range when she can't dodge. Her Encore can charm you, so stay out of its path.
Save Aqua Prison for when Shen commits with Shadow Dash or walks up; it stuns him and his taunt ends if you hit it first.
Shen's Shadow Dash taunts you, so stay behind your minions or ally and keep distance so he can't reach you easily.
Hit Shen with Ebb and Flow to bounce between him and your ally; it hurts him and heals your carry in the same cast.
Shen's empowered attacks after Twilight Assault hit hard, so don't stand next to him after he recalls his blade.
Put Tidecaller's Blessing on your carry before a trade so their attacks slow Shen.
After level 6, expect Stand United to bring Shen to a fight far away; use Tidal Wave to start fights on your terms.
Aim Aqua Prison at Sona when she walks up to cast. She has no escape except Song of Celerity's speed, and a stun makes her easy to kill.
Use Tidecaller's Blessing on your carry before trading so their hits slow Sona and her partner.
Spread out from Sona and stay apart from your partner so Crescendo cannot stun you both.
Use Ebb and Flow on Sona when it will bounce to your ally to heal them. It damages her and heals you both.
Hymn of Valor hits the nearest two enemies, so stand a little behind your partner to take less poke.
Aim Aqua Prison at Soraka when she walks forward to cast Starcall; a stunned Soraka cannot heal herself or her partner.
Dodge Starcall by moving out of its circle; it lands after a short delay, and a miss leaves her with no Rejuvenation.
Stay out of Equinox; its silence stops your spells, and the root that follows holds you in place for a follow-up.
Use Ebb and Flow on Soraka to bounce on to her partner; it hits enemies for damage, so it pokes in lane.
Fire Tidal Wave from far away at a squishy Soraka's team to start a fight; save Aqua Prison for whoever tries to run.
Keep your distance from Swain; Nevermove roots you, and Swain can then pull you to him.
Land Aqua Prison on Swain when he commits to Nevermove or Demonic Ascension, so your partner can follow up.
Move out of the way of Vision of Empire when you see the eye appear; it takes a moment to explode.
Use Tidecaller's Blessing on your partner before trading with Swain, so they slow him.
Aim Aqua Prison at Tahm Kench when he walks in, especially after he has been hit. Keep it for a moment he can't dodge.
Stay out of Tongue Lash's line and away from range. After three hits, Tahm Kench can Devour you.
Don't trade hits with Tahm Kench near the end of his Thick Skin; he heals back the stored damage when he is left alone.
If Tahm Kench uses the Thick Skin shield, he gives up healing and stops storing damage. Push the fight then.
Watch for Abyssal Dive. Stunning him while he channels cancels it, so hold Aqua Prison for that.
Hit Tahm Kench with Ebb and Flow when it also heals your ally; it hurts him and bounces on.
Throw Aqua Prison at Taric when he walks up to the minions; it is a long cooldown, so make it count.
Punish Taric when he walks up to attack; each Bravado hit cuts his cooldowns.
Dodge Dazzle by moving after you see Taric start it; the beam only bursts after a short delay.
Use Tidal Wave from far away to start a fight; it slows enemies for longer the farther it travels.
When Taric casts Cosmic Radiance, retreat or burst down a target before it ends; there is a long delay first.
Throw Aqua Prison at Thresh when he commits to a hook or walks up to trade; its long cooldown means you should not waste it.
Watch Thresh's cast animation for Death Sentence and step sideways, since the scythe stops at the first unit it hits. Keep a minion between you and him.
Hit Thresh with Ebb and Flow in a trade and let it bounce on to your ally, so you deal damage and heal in the same cast.
Put Tidecaller's Blessing on your ally before a trade so their hits leave Thresh slowed and he cannot walk up to you.
Aim Tidal Wave from far away at a Thresh who has just missed Death Sentence. It is slow, so he can dodge it if he sees it coming.
Vel'Koz has low mobility. Land Aqua Prison on him, then hit him with everything you have while he is stunned.
Hit Vel'Koz with Tidal Wave while he channels Life Form Disintegration Ray. The knock up interrupts it.
Stay out of a line with minions and step sideways to dodge Void Rift. It lands after a short delay.
Use Ebb and Flow on Vel'Koz when you can. It heals your ally and damages him, so it helps you win trades.
Empower your carry with Tidecaller's Blessing before they trade. Their hits will slow Vel'Koz, so he has a harder time dodging.
Hold Aqua Prison for when Xerath steps up to cast. If it hits, you and your partner can burst him.
Stay behind your minions or allies and out of line. Shocking Orb stuns the first enemy it hits.
Close the distance on Xerath. Up close he has little defense against you, and his Arcanopulse is hard to use while you are near.
When Xerath charges Arcanopulse he is slowed, so walk toward him sideways to dodge it.
Use Ebb and Flow on your partner when you trade. It hits Xerath too if he is close to you.
Tidal Wave can start a fight from far away. Use it when Xerath is stuck in place channeling Rite of the Arcane.
Aim Aqua Prison at Yuumi when she is not attached to an ally. While attached she cannot be targeted, so the bubble has nothing to hit.
Look for the moment Yuumi detaches or dashes to a new ally. Land Aqua Prison then to catch her stunned and exposed.
Bounce Ebb and Flow off the enemy carry onto your own ally. It hurts them and heals your team, so trade with it often.
Empower your carry with Tidecaller's Blessing before a trade so their hits leave the enemy slowed and are easier to chase.
Fire Tidal Wave from far away when the enemy carry is exposed. It slows more the farther it travels, but it is slow, so aim ahead.
Land Aqua Prison on Zilean and he is stunned and easy to kill. He is fragile, so commit with your carry.
Don't stand still near a Time Bomb on you. Move away from allies so the second bomb doesn't stun them.
Zilean's Rewind lets him throw a second Time Bomb quickly. Be ready to leave the area after the first one lands on you.
When Zilean uses Chronoshift on an ally, wait until it fades before finishing the kill.
Throw Aqua Prison when Zyra steps up to grow a plant; if it lands she is stunned and in trouble. Wait for it to be ready.
Step on Zyra's seeds to destroy them before she can grow plants from them.
Stay out of a line from Zyra so Grasping Roots misses; once it is spent, move in for your trade.
Use Ebb and Flow to heal your carry after plants hit, and to damage Zyra when she is close.
Kill plants quickly or fight away from them; they expire on their own and take fixed damage.
Put Tidecaller's Blessing on your attacker before a trade so their hits slow Zyra.
